cases.name: read-location-not-plain-control-0085

cases.name: read-location-normalized-separators
cases.note: The pattern is C:\Apps\Tool; the normalized location has an uppercase drive, '\' separators, repeated separators collapsed and no trailing separator, and compares ignoring case.

cases.name: read-location-normalized-case
cases.note: The pattern is C:\Apps\Tool; the normalized location has an uppercase drive, '\' separators, repeated separators collapsed and no trailing separator, and compares ignoring case.

cases.name: read-location-normalized-trailing-separators
cases.note: The pattern is C:\Apps\Tool; the normalized location has an uppercase drive, '\' separators, repeated separators collapsed and no trailing separator, and compares ignoring case.

cases.name: read-location-normalized-parent-not-covered
cases.note: The pattern is C:\Apps\Tool; the normalized location has an uppercase drive, '\' separators, repeated separators collapsed and no trailing separator, and compares ignoring case.

cases.name: read-location-normalized-child-not-covered
cases.note: The pattern is C:\Apps\Tool; the normalized location has an uppercase drive, '\' separators, repeated separators collapsed and no trailing separator, and compares ignoring case.

cases.name: read-location-pattern-normalized
cases.note: The pattern c:/apps/* is normalized as a location before matching.

cases.name: read-location-drive-root-normalized
cases.note: The normalized drive root keeps its separator: C:\.

cases.name: read-location-unicode-simple-case
cases.note: U+00E9's simple uppercase mapping is U+00C9 (UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line 234).

cases.name: read-location-unicode-no-full-case-mapping
cases.note: U+00DF has no simple uppercase mapping (UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line 224: '00DF;LATIN SMALL LETTER SHARP S;Ll;0;L;;;;;N;;;;;'), so it never equals 'SS'.

cases.name: read-location-one-from-parameter
cases.note: '--location' would ask for CustomInstallLocation, so the request is unreadable (§manager-winget). Control: read-location-plain-nested.

cases.name: read-location-field-and-terminated-parameter
cases.note: After '--' nothing names an option (§manager-winget), so there is one location.

cases.name: read-location-check-before-rules
cases.note: The check applies whatever the policy says: with no rules the check, not DefaultDeny, decides.

cases.name: read-location-not-used
cases.note: A request without CustomInstallLocation passes the check.

cases.name: read-location-plain-segment-leading-no-break-space
cases.note: The segment starts with U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE; only U+0020 is a space for the segment rules, and U+00A0 is outside the control ranges U+0000 to U+001F and U+007F to U+009F, so the path is plain; every location is granted. Control: read-location-not-plain-segment-leading-space.

cases.name: read-location-plain-segment-trailing-no-break-space
cases.note: The segment ends with U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE, which is not the space U+0020; every location is granted. Control: read-location-not-plain-segment-trailing-space.

cases.name: read-location-plain-segment-trailing-ideographic-space
cases.note: The segment ends with U+3000 IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE, which is not the space U+0020 and is outside the control ranges; every location is granted. Control: read-location-not-plain-segment-trailing-space.

cases.name: read-location-plain-repeated-after-drive
cases.note: After the drive's ':' and separator, any sequence of separators and segments follows, so a second separator right after the drive keeps the path plain; every location is granted. Control: read-location-plain-nested.

cases.name: read-location-normalized-repeated-after-drive
cases.note: 'C://Apps' is plain and normalizes to 'C:\Apps', with the repeated separator collapsed; the grant pattern is 'C:\Apps'. Control: read-location-normalized-separators.

cases.name: read-location-drive-root-repeated-separators
cases.note: 'C:\\' is plain; collapsing the separators leaves the drive root, whose trailing separator follows ':' and is kept, so it normalizes to 'C:\'; the grant pattern is 'C:\'. Control: read-location-drive-root-normalized.

cases.name: read-location-plain-powershell
cases.note: A plain local path through PowerShell; control for the read-location-not-plain cases through PowerShell.

cases.name: read-location-parameter-not-read
cases.note: The check reads only OptIns.CustomInstallLocation.Path: a Scoop custom parameter holding a relative path gives no install location, so the check does not apply. Control: read-location-not-plain-relative-powershell.

cases.name: read-location-not-plain-relative-powershell
cases.note: A relative path in OptIns.CustomInstallLocation.Path fails the check.
